summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #295 head 1814b4d0: runToggleEvidence defaults with Lua truthiness and performs relational/modulo operations before a runtime numeric preflight. Malformed false or metatable-backed cycle overrides therefore do not fail closed at the validation boundary; hostile values may execute metamethods. Default only exact nil, type-check before arithmetic/comparison, and regression-lock zero metamethod execution before integration.
evidence: PR #295 head 1814b4d08a02c9d650dea6288af9a8264e58d3c9 sets `local cycleCount = cycles or DEFAULT_TOGGLE_EVIDENCE_CYCLES`.
The same guard immediately evaluates `cycleCount >= 1`, `cycleCount <= MAX_TOGGLE_EVIDENCE_CYCLES`, and `cycleCount % 1` without a runtime number check.
`false :: any` is silently interpreted as the default 20-cycle request, while a metatable-backed table can participate in relational/arithmetic metamethod dispatch before rejection.
Review comment 5250458262 requests exact-nil defaulting, runtime numeric preflight, hostile-input regression, and post-#298 exact-head CI/ownership.
